Mayoral Zoning Override (MZO)

A complete, screenshot-by-screenshot walkthrough of the Mayoral Zoning Override (MZO) package process in the NYC HPD PIMS system — from the developer’s MZO request on the portal, through the ONS Borough Planning review, the Request Memo and Side Memo, the Draft Package reviews, and the Commissioner sign-off, to the Deputy Mayor’s approval and completion.

This guide follows one MZO package end to end so you can see what each screen does and what to expect next.

Tip: click any screenshot to enlarge it for a closer look.

About This Guide

A Mayoral Zoning Override (MZO) lets HPD seek a zoning override for an affordable-housing project that does not comply with existing zoning. In PIMS it is handled as a module on the project (the MZO Request module) and is worked through three milestones — Initial Review, Request Memo, and Package Review — before the package is signed by the HPD Commissioner and approved by the Deputy Mayor’s Office.

  • Started by the Developer Team on the portal, with a Support Memo (non-compliances) and illustrative Technical Drawings.
  • Reviewed by ONS Borough Planning and partner teams, with the milestone owner set automatically from the project’s borough.

Login is not covered here. Each part begins from the screen you see immediately after signing in as the relevant role.

Purpose of This Guide

A hands-on training reference. Each step pairs an actual screenshot with a clear Action (what to do) and Result (what to expect), with references to the MZO Future State Visio flow for traceability.

Who Should Use This Guide

  • Developer Team — submits the MZO request and prepares the Side Memo.
  • ONS Borough Planning — the Borough Planner (module owner, set by borough) and the Borough Planning Director.
  • HPD Environmental — the Director of Environmental (Deputy Director as backup), who decides if a Side Memo is required.
  • Program & Land Use — the Director of Program, LUP (Executive Director, Director, Planner), and the AC of Planning & Predevelopment.
  • HPD Legal (OLA) — the Contracts & Real Estate Attorney / Associate General Counsel and LAW review.
  • HPD Commissioner and the Deputy Mayor’s Office, plus DCP (external City agency).

Before You Begin

  • A valid PIMS account with the appropriate role (Developer, Borough Planner, Borough Planning Director, Environmental, Program/LUP, or Legal).
  • The project must exist in PIMS so the MZO Request can be initiated from the project record.
  • The MZO package components ready — Support Memo, Technical Drawings, Request Memo, Side Memo (if required), Draft Package, Full Package, and the Commissioner Signature Request Form.
  • A supported web browser (latest Google Chrome recommended).

Process at a Glance

  • 1Developer Team submits the MZO Request on the portal with the Support Memo & illustrative Technical Drawings
  • 2ONS Borough Planner picks up the request in PIMS; the MZO Request module & Initial Review milestone are created
  • 3Initial Review: the Borough Planner, DCP Borough Planner, and Borough Planning Director review & approve
  • 4Request Memo: the Borough Planner uploads the HPD Request Memo; Director of Environmental decides if a Side Memo is required; Legal (LAW) reviews
  • 5Package Review: the Draft Package is reviewed by the Borough Planning Director, Director of Program, LUP, C&RE Attorney, and AC of Planning & Predevelopment
  • 6Commissioner Signature Request Form is completed; Sign Off with the Full Package; the DM Approval Memo is uploaded
  • 7ULURP eligibility is set and the milestone is completed — the MZO Request module is Completed

Part A — Submit the MZO Request (Developer Portal)

Step 1: Log in to the PIMS Portal

Action Log in to the PIMS external portal as the developer. The home page shows My Inquiries, My Proposals, My Requests, and My Projects. An MZO request can be started a few ways — from the MZO Request link, from My Requests, or from a specific project. Here we start from the project.

Result You are signed in to the developer portal.

Process map reference: Visio — Start: the Dev Team identifies the need for a zoning override and informs HPD Borough Planning.

Step 2: Open the Project and Add a Request

Action Open the project you want the MZO request for — Atlantic Housing Partners LLC. You can see the project information and attached documents. On the right, under the My Requests related list, click Add New.

Result The request-type selection opens.

Step 3: Select MZO Package Request

Action Choose the request type to initiate. Click MZO Package Request — Complete Form.

Result The New MZO Request form opens.

Process map reference: Visio Step 1 — MZO Request.

Step 4: Complete the MZO Request Form

Action On the New MZO Request form the Project Name, Date Initiated, and time are auto-populated (because the request starts from the project record, the project name cannot be edited). Add any additional comments and click Next.

Result The request is created and the document step opens.

Step 5: Review the Required Documents

Action Two documents are required to proceed: the Support Memo (technical memo detailing non-compliances) and the Technical Memo / Drawings (illustrative technical drawings). On a document line, click the upload icon.

Result The upload dialog opens.

Process map reference: Visio Step 1 — upload Support Memo & illustrative technical drawings.

Step 6: Upload the Document

Action In the Upload Documents dialog, choose the file from your computer and click Upload. Repeat for the second document.

Result The files are attached to the request.

Step 7: Submit the Request

Action Once both documents are uploaded, click Submit.

Result The MZO request is submitted to HPD.

Step 8: Submission Confirmation

Action The system confirms your application has been submitted. You can View Application Page or go back to the home page — click View Application Page.

Result The confirmation is shown.

Step 9: View the Submitted Request

Action On the MZO Request application page you can see the status is Submitted along with all the information you entered.

Result The developer’s submission is complete; the request now moves to HPD for review.

Part B — Pick Up the Request: ONS Borough Planner

Step 10: Log in to PIMS (Internal Backend)

Action Log in to the PIMS internal application. The Home dashboard shows Action Items, Active Modules, and Pending Milestones.

Result You are signed in to the internal side of PIMS.

Process map reference: Visio Step 2 — MZO Request Review (ONS Borough Planner).

Step 11: Open the Object Menu

Action Click the object drop-down at the top to see the available objects.

Result The object list opens.

Step 12: Open License Applications

Action Select the License Applications object. The Recently Viewed list opens.

Result The License Applications list opens.

Step 13: Switch to the MZO Request List View

Action From the list-view drop-down, switch to the MZO Request list view. Using the inline filters you can see the submitted requests — BLA-0000000582 for Atlantic Housing Partners LLC is Submitted. Click it.

Result The submitted MZO application opens.

Step 14: Mark the Application Status as Complete

Action The MZO application opens in Submitted status. To begin working it, click Mark Application Status as Complete.

Result The application is accepted for processing.

Step 15: Open the Module Tab

Action The application is now in preview. Next to the Documents tab a new Module tab has appeared — click it.

Result The Module tab opens.

Step 16: Open the MZO Request Module

Action A new module — MZO Request - Atlantic Housing Partners LLC — has been created. Click the module to open it.

Result The MZO Request module opens.

Step 17: Open the Initial Review Milestone

Action The module is In Progress and a milestone — MZO Request Initial Review — has been created. Click the milestone record ID to open it.

Result The Initial Review milestone opens.

Step 18: Start the Initial Review Milestone

Action The milestone owner is the Bronx Borough Planner — the borough planner is set automatically from the project’s borough (e.g., a Manhattan project would be owned by the Manhattan Borough Planner). As the Borough Planner, click Mark Status as Complete to move the status to In Progress.

Result The milestone is active.

Step 19: Review and Submit for Approval

Action With the status In Progress, review all the information and click Submit for Approval.

Result The Initial Review is ready to route for approval.

Part C — Initial Review: Borough Planner, DCP & Director

Step 20: Add Comments and Submit

Action Add the appropriate comments and click Submit.

Result The request is routed for approval.

Step 21: Approval Work Item — Initial Review

Action Under the tabs, click Approval Work Item to see the approval workflow for this process.

Result The approval routing is shown.

Step 22: Log in as the Borough Planning Director

Action Log in as the Bronx Borough Planning Director. On the Home page, under Action Items, the Atlantic Housing Partners LLC project is assigned to the Borough Planning Director — click View to go straight to the milestone.

Result The Initial Review milestone opens for the Director.

Process map reference: Visio Step 2b — ONS Borough Planning Director reviews the request.

Step 23: Director Reviews and Approves

Action On the MZO Request Initial Review milestone, the Borough Planning Director reviews the details. On the right, the approval action lets you Approve, Reject, or Conditionally Approve. Select Approve, add decision comments, and click Submit.

Result The Director’s approval is recorded.

Step 24: Back to the Borough Planner — DCP Review Stage

Action Once approved by the Director, the record returns to the Borough Planner. On the right, the Action Item is the DCP Review stage: please confirm that the DCP review has been completed.

Result The request reaches the DCP review confirmation step.

Process map reference: Visio Steps 3–4 — Borough Planner emails the request to the DCP Borough Planner for review.

Step 25: Email the Request to DCP

Action The Borough Planner sends an email to the DCP Borough Planner for the MZO package request review (copying the ONS Borough Planning Director).

Result DCP review is requested outside PIMS.

Process map reference: Visio Step 4 — DCP Borough Planner reviews the request.

Step 26: Confirm the DCP Review

Action The Borough Planner selects Yes, adds the DCP comments, and clicks Submit.

Result The DCP review is recorded on the request.

Process map reference: Visio Step 5 — Borough Planning Director marks DCP’s review complete.

Step 27: Submit for Approval after DCP Review

Action Once the DCP review is complete and the comments are added, the Borough Planner clicks Submit for Approval.

Result The request routes back to the Borough Planning Director.

Step 28: Director Approves the Initial Review

Action Log in as the Bronx Borough Planning Director. On the approval action, click Approve, add decision comments, and click Submit.

Result The Director’s final approval on the Initial Review is recorded.

Step 29: Initial Review Complete

Action With the Director’s approval, the milestone is marked Completed and the MZO Stage is Approved.

Result The Initial Review milestone is complete.

Step 30: Request Memo Milestone Created

Action Navigate back to the MZO Request - Atlantic Housing Partners LLC module. The MZO Request Initial Review shows Completed, and a new MZO Request Memo milestone has been created. Click it to open.

Result The process moves into the Request Memo milestone.

Process map reference: Visio Step 6 — Borough Planner prepares & uploads the draft HPD Request Memo.

Step 31: Start the Request Memo Milestone

Action The MZO Request Memo milestone opens with status Not Started. Click Mark Status as Complete to move it to In Progress.

Result The Request Memo milestone is active.

Step 32: Go to the Documents App

Step 39: Verify the Document

Action Review the document. You can Request more information, Reject, or Verify it. Click Verify.

Step 40: Add Comments and Submit

Action Add the appropriate comments and click Submit.

Step 41: Record the Approval Decision

Step 42: Log in as the Director of Environmental

Action Log in as the Director of Environmental. On the Home page, the Atlantic Housing Partners LLC project is assigned to the Director of Environmental Planning — click View to go to the milestone.

Step 43: Review and Decide if a Side Memo is Required

Action Review the MZO Request Memo milestone (status In Progress) and all its documents and information. Approve the Request Memo and indicate whether a Side Memo is required, add the appropriate comments, and click Submit.

Step 45: Upload the Side Memo

Step 48: Log in as the Associate General Counsel

Result The milestone opens for Legal review.

Step 49: Legal Reviews the Request Memo

Action As the Associate General Counsel, review the milestone and Approve, Reject, or Conditionally Approve it. Add decision comments and submit. Once approved, it returns to the Borough Planner.

Result Legal’s decision is recorded.

Step 50: Borough Planner Logs the LAW Decision

Action Back with the Borough Planner, who works with the Law team and, based on their comments, takes a decision, adds comments, and clicks Submit.

Result The LAW decision is logged on the request memo.

Process map reference: Visio Step 18 — Borough Planner logs LAW approval & updates the Request Memo.

Step 51: Request Memo Milestone Complete

Action The MZO Request Memo milestone is now Completed and the MZO Stage is Approved.

Step 62: Borough Planning Director Final Review

Action The record moves to the Borough Planning Director Draft Package Final Review stage. Select Approve, add decision comments, and click Submit.

Process map reference: Visio Step 25 — ONS Borough Planning Director reviews the MZO Draft Package.

Action The milestone moves to the Sign Off stage (Under Sign Off). Guidance: prepare and upload the Full Package under Documents → Full Package, which should include the Final Request Memo, Technical Drawings, Completed Routing Sheet, and Signature Request Form.

Step 64: Go to Documents and Upload the Full Package

Action Click the Documents tab. The Full Package shows as Pending — upload it.

Step 65: Full Package Submitted

Action The Full Package now shows Submitted.

Step 66: Documents Verified

Action On the Document Checklist, the Draft Package is Verified and the DM Approval Memo / Full Package show Submitted as the package moves through sign-off.

Result The package documents are reviewed.

Process map reference: Visio Steps 28–29 — HPD Commissioner initials the package; Executive Assistant returns it.

Step 67: Upload the DM Approval Memo

Action Once approved, upload the DM Approval Memo under Documents → DM Approval Memo, then update the MZO Sub-Stage field in the Details section to Sign Off Completed & Uploaded.

Process map reference: Visio Steps 30–32 — Commissioner signature logged; LAW & Deputy Mayor approval.

Step 68: Update the MZO Sub-Stage

Action In the Details section, set the MZO Sub-Stage to Sign Off Completed & Uploaded and click Save.

Result The sub-stage is updated.

Action In ULURP Eligibility Review, set Is the project seeking ULURP? (here, No) and click Save.

Action The Is the project seeking ULURP? field now shows the saved answer.

Action On the project record’s Modules list you can see the full picture — Article XI, C&S Underwriting, CP - Original, CP - Amendment1, and MZO Request (Completed).

Summary

You followed a Mayoral Zoning Override (MZO) package from start to finish. The Developer Team submits the MZO request on the portal with the Support Memo and Technical Drawings. The ONS Borough Planner picks it up in PIMS, which creates the MZO Request module and its Initial Review milestone. The request is reviewed and approved by the Borough Planner, the DCP Borough Planner, and the Borough Planning Director. The Borough Planner then prepares the Request Memo; the Director of Environmental determines whether a Side Memo is required, and Legal reviews. The Draft Package is reviewed across the Borough Planning Director, Director of Program, LUP, the Contracts & Real Estate Attorney, and the AC of Planning & Predevelopment; the Commissioner Signature Request Form is completed, the Full Package is assembled for the Commissioner’s signature, and the Deputy Mayor’s Approval Memo is uploaded. After the ULURP eligibility is set, all three milestones complete and the MZO Request module is marked Completed.

Notes & Disclaimers

  • This guide follows the standard approved path; rejections and conditional acceptances route the package back for updates (Visio steps such as 2a, 9, 15a/16a/17a, 19a–25a). Repetitive approvals are condensed and shown via the Approval Work Item tab.
  • Some steps (DCP review, City Law / LAW review, the Commissioner’s signature, and the Deputy Mayor’s approval) happen partly outside PIMS by email; PIMS records the key dates, documents, and approvals.
  • Screens, field names, and buttons may vary by role, permissions, browser, and future PIMS updates. Names, IDs, and data shown are from a training/sandbox environment.
